paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作部分将目标论文归类为基于无线信号的窃听方法之一，将其与WiFi、mmWave等方法并列，作为RFID窃听的代表性工作提及。正文未对目标论文进行方法使用、性能比较或详细技术描述，仅作为普通相关工作引用。

evidences.evidence_quote: Wireless signals have also been exploited by researchers for sound recovery [8]–[13].
evidences.evidence_context: Wireless signals have also been exploited by researchers for sound recovery [8]–[13]. Hu et al. [11] introduced mmEcho, which uses mmWave to measure vibrations for eavesdropping, while Hu et al. [10] developed MILLIEAR, which reconstructs audio from vibrations using generative models. Wei et al. [9] demonstrated acoustic eavesdropping using WiFi signals, and Wang et al. [12] expanded eavesdropping through Impulse Radio Ultra-Wideband (IR-UWB) technology with their UWHear system. RFID-based methods have also been explored, with Wang et al. [13] showing how audio can be intercepted via RFID.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 该引用出现在相关工作段落中，作为列举的多个引用之一（[8]–[13]），没有单独描述目标论文的具体贡献或方法，属于普通相关工作列举，且未提及亚毫米级、穿墙或RFID扬声器振动等关键词。根据规则，分组引用且无单独描述时推荐为exclude。
